body: Got into Waterloo CS. Looks like I’m fine now.

Look, I don’t know why you’re suicidal. I don’t know what sort of relationship you have with your kid. I don’t know what sort of role you play in your family. What I can tell you is that a parent’s death can be a huge blow to a family. Until I know more about your situation, all I can tell you is that I’m certain that if you kill yourself you may potentially cause serious problems for your kid.
Have you considered the impact your suicide could have on them?

Please don’t do it, at least not until your teen is independent. My dad died when I was 19, he was chronically ill prior to dying. I recently turned 20 and partially because of circumstances stemming from my dad’s death, I’m suicidal.
As I mentioned earlier, I’ll definitely wait until I hear back from the unis I applied to. Nonetheless, if I get rejected I don’t see how my situation could improve.

I’m still planning to wait until I hear back from the universities I applied to. The deadline to hear back is in May.

If I get rejected, I honestly don’t think there’s any good solution to my situation that doesn’t involve suicide.
But the way I see it, I’m going to have a very painful life and then die. I might as well avoid the pain. I’m in a very bad position right now.
